title: Typed entity/compound-geometry and BLOCK byte capture bounds
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Add aggregate adapter-byte admission to existing typed entity callback record limits

Account common DRW_Entity dynamic values, the DRW_ModelerGeometry ACIS/SAB carrier path, ACIS surfaces, explicit MESH topology, curves, compound boundaries, DIMENSION/LEADER/MLEADER members, TABLE copies and INSERT-owned attributes
Account BLOCK start and ENDBLK dynamic metadata, including the inline dx_ifaceBlock storage estimate
Use generated fast controls without adding or downloading drawing fixtures

controls: Entity estimates include concrete inline size and common dynamic base fields before copying
Modeler and surface estimates include raw, DWG ACIS/SAB, DataStorage, chunk/range, subtype binary/reference, and optional decoded-wireframe payloads
MESH estimates include cage/subdivision vertices, nested face indices, edge/crease data and override-property vectors
SPLINE, polyline, hatch, MLINE, TEXT/MTEXT, DIMENSION, LEADER, MLEADER, INSERT/ATTRIB, and TABLE estimates include their audited nested vectors, strings and deep-copied children
The extra typed TABLE snapshot shares the aggregate entity-byte budget with its block-entity copy
BLOCK estimates cover start-record dynamic fields and separately admitted ENDBLK dynamic fields
Counters advance only after successful container insertion or assignment
Over-budget and allocation failures remain sticky and fileExport refuses before publication
implementation.limitations: Logical slot/payload accounting is not an allocator or RSS bound. Dynamic members in entity-specific families outside the enumerated modeler/surface/mesh/curve/compound/table paths, and remaining auxiliary stores, are not covered by this slice; 7S.2c census remains open.

localEvidence: Generated LINE capture accounted for proxy-graphics string bytes in addition to the concrete inline object size.
Generated ModelerGeometry capture accounted for raw frame bytes, exact DWG ACIS/SAB bytes, and DataStorage bytes without conflating their meanings.
Generated ExtrudedSurface capture accounted for ACIS carrier and subtype binary data; generated MESH capture accounted for nested topology and override-property vectors.
Generated SPLINE, LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, MLINE, and HATCH controls covered curve arrays, vertex/XDATA/SEQEND state, nested parameter arrays, boundary loops, and deep-copied boundary entities.
Generated TEXT and INSERT controls covered text strings, attribute-owned nested MTEXT data, R2018 attribute arrays, attribute handles, and SEQEND state.
Generated DIMENSION, LEADER, and MLEADER controls covered private dimension strings, leader vertices, nested roots/lines/breaks, block labels, text, and column sizes.
Generated TABLE controls covered the separate typed snapshot and block entity copy, nested cell text/attributes, CAD values and raw bytes, with aggregate byte refusal before partial table retention.
A byte-budget refusal left entity counters and the block entity list unchanged and set sticky capture failure.
Generated BLOCK start and ENDBLK controls accounted for preview and description bytes; seeded over-budget controls refused before retention.
Existing record-count boundary and destination-preservation controls remain in the same focused selector.
No source drawing fixture was downloaded, added, or committed.

planImpact.remainingCensus: Continue per-family dynamic-member estimates for RTEXT, OLE/underlay and other uncovered entity families; complete the remaining auxiliary-store inventory.
